description: Muse Spark scene-understanding output for one engine-bay keyframe: named components (each with a short SAM-ready concept noun plus an optional shorter fallback) and visible anomalies with region hints.

region_hint.description: Where in the frame to look, e.g. 'upper left near the battery'. Free text; a box/point prompt may be derived from it.

name.description: Human-readable part name, e.g. 'battery negative terminal'.

sam_concept.description: ONE short common noun for one SAM 3.1 request, 1-2 words (e.g. 'battery', 'air filter', 'radiator cap'). Never a comma list; longer phrases segment badly.

sam_fallback.description: Optional even-shorter everyday name, used only when sam_concept finds nothing (one retry).
